name: Nameplate & Manual Scout
description: FIFO parallel pre-flight of local asset ledger + nameplate/data-plate context followed by a 200-turn ReAct OCR/service-manual/recall/OEM-vs-aftermarket part-number scout that persists structured maintenance cards and parts cross-references.

phases.name: Phase 1: Parallel FIFO Local Ledger & Inventory Probe
phases.description: Pulls existing assets, service intervals, torque specs, and parts stock concurrently before Turn 1.

phases.name: Phase 2: ReAct Nameplate OCR, Service Manual & OEM/Aftermarket Part Scout
phases.prompt_template:
Execute the Shop Bench Nameplate & Manual Scout workflow.

INPUTS:
- Asset ID: {{params.asset_id | (create or match in ledger)}}
- Uploaded Nameplate Photo: {{params.image_path | (none)}}
- Equipment Hint: {{params.equipment_hint | (read from photo or active asset)}}
- Output artifact path: {{result_path}}

PHASE 1 LOCAL LEDGER SNAPSHOT:
{{phase.preflight_ledger.ledger}}

STEPS:
1. If `image_path` is provided and non-empty, call `vision_analyze` on `{{params.image_path}}` to transcribe exact make, model, serial/VIN, engine family, voltage/BTU/HP ratings, and spec numbers from the data plate.
2. Use `web_search` (when online) or mechanical reference knowledge to look up:
   - Official service intervals & fluid capacities (oil viscosity/capacity, spark plug gap, filter intervals)
   - Key torque specs (drain plug, wheel lugs/blade bolt, head/spark plug)
   - OEM part numbers + reliable aftermarket cross-references (e.g. WIX, NGK, ACDelco, Gates)
   - Any major safety recalls or common known failure points.
3. Persist the findings directly into Shop Bench SQLite using `shop_asset_save` (if creating/updating asset specs) and `shop_spec_save` (`kind='interval'`, `kind='torque'`, `kind='part'`, and a summary `kind='log'`).
4. Write structured JSON to `{{result_path}}` via `file_write` with keys: `workflow`, `asset_id`, `identified_equipment`, `intervals_added`, `torque_specs_added`, `parts_xref`, `recalls_or_notes`, and `summary_markdown`.
5. Call `milestone_complete` and return a concise shop card.
